title: one-change changelog entry (omnibase_spi#67)
prompt:
Summarize the merged change below in at most two sentences for a changelog: what changed, then why. Name the pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the change text. Also name the ticket OMN-1478.

--- change 1 (repo omnibase_spi, pull request #67) ---
feat(protocols): add ProtocolIntentClassifier for intent classification [OMN-1478] (#67)
* feat(protocols): add ProtocolIntentClassifier for intent classification [OMN-1478]

Add new intelligence protocol domain with ProtocolIntentClassifier for
classifying user intents from text content. This protocol enables the
ONEX platform to support intent-based routing and analysis.

Changes:
- Create protocols/intelligence/ domain with ProtocolIntentClassifier
- Protocol uses Core models via TYPE_CHECKING (ModelIntentClassificationInput,
  ModelIntentClassificationOutput from omnibase_core 0.9.3)
- Add protocol exports to main protocols/__init__.py
- Add 23 comprehensive tests for protocol compliance
- Bump omnibase-core dependency to >=0.9.3

Supported intent categories (9 total):
- Original 6: code_generation, debugging, refactoring, testing,
  documentation, analysis
- Intelligence 3: pattern_learning, quality_assessment, semantic_analysis

* chore(tests): remove unused pytest import from conftest [OMN-1478]

* feat(protocols): add ProtocolIntentGraph for intent persistence abstraction [OMN-1479]

Add ProtocolIntentGraph protocol for intent graph persistence operations:
- store_intent() - Store intent classification to graph database
- get_session_intents() - Query intents for a session with filtering
- health_check() - Health check for graph connectivity

Changes:
- New protocol in protocols/intelligence/protocol_intent_graph.py
- 36 comprehensive unit tests for protoco

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
